entries.description: Read stub spec, prerequisite Set B UAT checklist, and project-guidance.md; verified API keys.
Promoted 'trust business + auditor backstop over auto-detection tooling' to Principle under Security And Organization Model in docs/planning/project-guidance.md.
Routed planning task to flesh out spec.md into per-session plan, risk notes, and exit criteria.

Spliced fleshed-out Session Plan (8 sessions), Risk notes, and Exit criteria into spec.md. Standardized Session 1's format (Steps/Creates/Touches/Progress keys/Ends with) to match downstream sessions. Updated Session 8 to explicitly include Playwright suite run and change-log generation via task_type='summarization' per prior lesson.

dotnet build Dabbler.Platform.sln: 0 errors, 183 warnings (all expected [Obsolete] cascades from Set B). dotnet test (non-Playwright): 0 failed, 667 passed across 6 assemblies (Dabbler.Components 33, Dabbler.Reports.Blazor 13, Dabbler.Security.Blazor 192, AcmeCoffeeOnline.Api 27, Dabbler.Security 279, AcmeCoffeeOnline.Web 123). Playwright suite intentionally skipped — Session 1 ships no behavioural change.
Cross-provider verification via task_type=session-verification. Verifier: opus. Raw review saved to session-reviews/session-001.md.

Addressed three Minor issues from round-1 verification: added Session 7 step 7 (new UX assertions) and step 8 (regression re-run); rewrote Finding 6 exit-criteria bullet to credit Sessions 4 and 7; added finding-6 co-reference to Session 7 step 2.
Round-2 cross-provider verification after fixing three Minor round-1 issues. Verifier: opus.

Diagnosed UAT finding 1. Root cause: UsersMasterGrid.OnInitializedAsync and UserRoleAssignmentDetails.OnInitializedAsync run concurrently during the initial Users-tab render. Both call through AdminUserQueryService, which held a scoped DabblerSecurityDbContext. Concurrent awaits on the same EF context throw 'A second operation was started on this context instance', followed by an ObjectDisposedException from the RemoteRenderer once the circuit unwinds.

Refactored AdminUserQueryService to depend on IDbContextFactory<DabblerSecurityDbContext>. Each public method now creates a fresh context via `await using var db = await _dbFactory.CreateDbContextAsync(ct)`. Internal helper `LoadActorAssignedOrganizationIdsAsync(db, ct)` reuses the caller's context so GetUsersAsync still runs its two queries on a single context instance while GetActorAssignedOrganizationIdsAsync (called from UserRoleAssignmentDetails) creates its own context — eliminating the concurrent-await collision. Updated 5 unit tests in AdminUserQueryServiceTests.cs to supply a factory and added a new ConcurrentCallsDoNotThrow regression guard that issues three parallel service calls and asserts no exception.

Added AddDbContextFactory<DabblerSecurityDbContext> to AddDabblerSecurity in ServiceCollectionExtensions.cs alongside the existing AddDbContext call. Registered with ServiceLifetime.Scoped so it remains compatible with the scoped DbContextOptions<T> produced by AddDbContext — the default Singleton lifetime triggered 'Cannot consume scoped service DbContextOptions from singleton IDbContextFactory' in the 16 WebApplicationFactory-backed Web tests. Also changed UseEfCoreStore's pre-existing factory registration to Scoped for consistency even though it is not exercised by the current Web host (UseJsonFileStore is the active path). Audited sibling Blazor EF consumers: OrganizationMasterGrid and OrganizationDetailsForm inject scoped DabblerSecurityDbContext directly but do not trigger concurrent initial awaits (OrganizationMasterGrid's OnInitializedAsync is the only initial query; OrganizationDetailsForm queries only on user selection). Flagged for the verifier but deliberately left out of scope — Session 4 will restructure OrganizationMasterGrid for in-circuit refresh and is the natural owner of any further factory migration there.

Created tests/AcmeCoffeeOnline.Playwright/SecurityDashboardUatCoverageTests.cs with three tests covering UAT finding 1: UsersTab_LoadsForSystemAdmin_NoCircuitCrashAsync (the core regression guard), UsersTab_LoadsForSystemAdmin_GridProjectsSeededRowsAsync (operability proof that seeded rows render), and UsersTab_RapidRemountDoesNotCrashAsync (defensive remount under the original concurrent-init pressure; uses Force=true on tab-strip clicks because the MudTabs re-render leaves a transient pointer-event overlay — the test's purpose is regression-guarding the DbContext fix, not proving tab-click UX). Each test method carries a `// UAT:` cross-reference comment per the newly promoted Human UAT Philosophy convention. Scaffold generated via route(task_type='test-generation') → gemini-pro; applied with minor stylistic cleanups (using-before-namespace ordering, non-nullable page var, Assertions.Expect style matching existing files).

Build green (0 errors; expected [Obsolete] cascade warnings). Non-Playwright test suite: 668 passed / 0 failed across 6 assemblies (Dabbler.Components 33, Dabbler.Reports.Blazor 13, Dabbler.Security.Blazor 192, AcmeCoffeeOnline.Api 27, Dabbler.Security 280 — +1 from baseline for the new ConcurrentCallsDoNotThrow test, AcmeCoffeeOnline.Web 123). Playwright Security Dashboard regression set: 14 passed / 0 failed across four classes (SecurityDashboardUatCoverageTests x3 new, SecurityDashboardFiveTabSmokeTests x2, UsersAndRoleAssignmentWorkflowTests x1, SecurityDashboardFullSweepTests x8). Full Playwright suite not run on this session (explicitly scoped by spec risk notes to the dashboard coverage since that is the regression surface the DbContextFactory change touches); broader regression falls to Session 3 and Session 4 as new behaviour lands.
Cross-provider verification via task_type=session-verification. Verifier: opus.

Addressed four Minor round-1 issues: replaced placebo ConcurrentCallsDoNotThrow test with a CountingDbContextFactory-backed EachPublicMethodResolvesItsOwnDbContext wiring assertion; extracted ConfigureSecurityDbContext local function to eliminate the duplicated DbContext configuration lambda; ran the full Playwright suite; disclosed that UserRoleAssignmentDetails.razor was unchanged despite the spec's pessimistic 'Touches' listing.
Round-2 cross-provider verification after the four Minor round-1 fixes. Verifier: opus.

Closed UAT Finding 2 (Security nav hidden for non-SystemAdmin). Added CanReachSecurityDashboard field to ShellSessionState (computed via BakedInRoles.All) in ShellSessionStateLoader.cs; restructured the Admin nav group in MainLayout.razor so the Security Dashboard link surfaces for any baked-in role holder. Tab visibility remains a compiled-privilege decision (no Session 3 change to DabblerPageAuthorize or user-roles.json). This was carried over from the prior-attempt session (Sonnet 4.6 Max) that ran out of context before shipping.

Added four Playwright tests in SecurityDashboardUatCoverageTests.cs using explicit roles: override: SecurityNav_SystemAdmin_NavVisible_And_FiveTabsAsync, SecurityNav_CrossOrgUserAdmin_NavVisible_And_ThreeTabsAsync, SecurityNav_BakedInUser_NavVisible_And_RoleDocOnlyAsync, and UsersTab_LoadsForCrossOrgUserAdmin_NoCircuitCrashAsync (Session 2 regression re-run on the newly-permitted persona).

Fixed a .NET 10 Docker infrastructure bug blocking every Playwright test (99/99 failing on /_framework/blazor.web.js 404). Root cause: Dockerfile.Web's publish step used --no-restore after a csproj-only restore — under .NET 10 SDK (confirmed 10.0.201) that suppresses Blazor static-asset discovery and leaves blazor.web.js out of wwwroot/_framework/ and the static-web-assets endpoints manifest. The same source under .NET 11 preview SDK publishes correctly, which masked the bug locally (dev machine had 11.0.100-preview.2). Fix: dropped --no-restore from docker/Dockerfile.Web. Also adopted the canonical .NET 10 Blazor template pattern in Program.cs and App.razor — removed UseStaticFiles(), moved MapStaticAssets() adjacent to MapRazorComponents() in the endpoint section, switched the <script> tag to the @Assets[] helper. Diagnosed via: curl /_framework/blazor.web.js from inside the playwright container, copying the publish manifest out via docker cp, and replicating the Dockerfile staged restore pattern in an ad-hoc SDK container to isolate the culprit.

Fixed two more pre-existing Docker infrastructure issues surfaced once the blazor.web.js 404 was resolved. (a) /test-auth/* endpoints returned 403 for playwright → web requests because IsLoopbackOrInMemoryRequest rejects bridge-network traffic. Added Authentication:SeededSession:AllowNonLoopback opt-in (defaults to false; takes effect only when Development or Test and SeededSession:Enabled=true) and enabled it via env var in docker-compose.yml for the web service. Endpoint guards now bypass the loopback check when the flag is set while still enforcing the shared secret. (b) web service inherited the LocalDB connection string from appsettings.Development.json (api had been overridden; web had not), causing PlatformNotSupportedException → HTTP 500 on every authenticated request. Added ConnectionStrings__DefaultConnection env var to the web service in docker-compose.yml matching the api's sqlserver connection string.

Full Docker Playwright suite: 95 passed / 4 failed out of 99 (prior baseline: 1 passed / 98 failed). All 9 Session 3-relevant tests passed (7 SecurityDashboardUatCoverageTests + 2 SecurityDashboardFiveTabSmokeTests). The 4 remaining failures are pre-existing Docker-specific bugs previously masked by the blazor.web.js 404 and are not caused by Session 3's changes: SmokeTests.AdminNavigation_UsesFocusedProductsEntryAndActualRolePermissionsAsync (access-denied assertion on /admin/products), RestrictionEnforcementTests.CustomerRole_SeesUnitPriceFieldButReadOnlyAsync (HTTP 500 on /products/17 via web → api 401), OrdersWorkflowTests.OrderDetail_SystemAdmin_CanEditNotesAndPersistAsync (sqlserver state pollution between runs), EdgeCaseTests.AccessDenied_CustomerRole_BlockedFromCustomersPageAsync (access-denied UI contract drift). Filed as Finding 10 in spec.md with Session 4 Step 0 triage assignment so they are not indefinitely deferred. Non-Playwright build + test suites stayed green.

Cross-provider verification via task_type=session-verification, max_tier=2 to route to a non-Anthropic provider (Sessions 1 and 2 used opus). Verifier: gemini-pro. Verdict: Pass — no issues raised. Raw review saved to session-reviews/session-003.md. One benign observation: the DatabaseInitializer.cs MigrateAsync → EnsureCreatedAsync change (a prior-attempt Session 3 Docker fix that also shipped in this commit) was noted as low-risk and non-regressive.
